Seborrheic keratosis typically presents as a warty, flesh-colored or brownish lesion that is usually not raised or itchy.
follow_up_considerations: Recommend a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis and rule out any potential malignancy.
Monitor the lesion for any changes in size, shape, or color.
Educate the patient on sun protection and regular skin checks.
